steps.description: Create a Terrenia world from the shipped local package closure and a chosen or generated seed. Frozen-lock preflight must complete before any world writer is opened. The current finite -8..8 playable fixture is a non-production smoke only; V0 does not claim a production lock and does not claim a durable writer.
steps.client_expectation: The launcher world library creates the world from the frozen local package closure after successful frozen-lock preflight and does not open a writer on preflight failure. The windowed DefaultPlugins playable fixture is a non-production smoke only.
steps.headless_expectation: The same create sequence runs through command injection in a GPU-free headless Bevy App and refuses to open a writer until frozen-lock preflight succeeds. No production lock or durable writer is claimed for V0.
authoritative_assertions: Create completes frozen lock preflight before any world writer is opened.
Create uses the shipped local package closure and seed rather than a host-hidden Terrenia fallback.
V0 does not claim a production lock and does not claim a durable writer; the current finite -8..8 playable fixture is a non-production smoke only.

steps.description: Spawn at a validated, safe surface location in a Y-up world. The current finite -8..8 playable fixture is a non-production smoke only and is not a production spawn contract.
steps.client_expectation: The client presents the local player at the validated surface spawn using Bevy right-handed Y-up world coordinates. The finite fixture spawn is a non-production smoke only.
steps.headless_expectation: Headless command injection spawns the same validated player pose without a window or GPU and does not treat the finite fixture as production spawn.
authoritative_assertions: Spawn occurs at a validated safe surface location in a Y-up world (+X right, +Y up, conventional forward -Z).
Spawn clearance, footing, hazard, fluid, cave, and active-chunk readiness checks pass before the player is placed.
Distances are meters and angles are radians.

steps.description: Walk, look, jump, inspect the targeted block, and traverse continuously as chunks stream around the player. The current finite -8..8 playable fixture is a non-production smoke only and does not provide production chunk streaming.
steps.client_expectation: Client input walks, looks, jumps, and inspects the targeted block while chunks stream around the player with a bounded resident set. The finite fixture walk is a non-production smoke only.
steps.headless_expectation: Headless command injection performs the same move, look, jump, and inspect sequence without a window or GPU and does not accept the finite fixture as production exploration.
authoritative_assertions: Exploration keeps a bounded resident set through chunk streaming around the player.
Negative X/Z coordinates are first-class; normal play exposes no authored world edge.
Inspection reports the authoritative targeted block without mutating world state.

steps.description: Explore multiple surface territories, find a cave entrance, and enter a traversable underground region.
steps.client_expectation: The client can reach a required cave entrance from the surface and continue into a traversable underground region without falling into an unready collider void.
steps.headless_expectation: Headless command injection reaches the same cave entrance and underground region with identical occupancy and clearance receipts.
authoritative_assertions: A required cave entrance is reachable from the surface and leads into a traversable underground region.
Portal position, tangent, clearance, and fluid state at the cave entrance satisfy the frozen cave plan.
No entrance opens into an unready collider void, unsafe spawn, or unexplained fluid discontinuity.

steps.description: Gather wood, soil, stone, and at least one ore without duplication or loss.
steps.client_expectation: Client gathering places wood, soil, stone, and at least one ore into inventory without duplicating or losing stacks.
steps.headless_expectation: Headless command injection gathers the same wood, soil, stone, and ore with identical inventory receipts and no conservation loss.
authoritative_assertions: Gathering yields wood, soil, stone, and at least one ore without duplication or loss.
Drop and pickup conservation holds for every gathered stack.
Full-inventory gathering does not destroy the source drop or the existing inventory.

steps.description: Craft a workbench and basic wooden and stone tools from package-authored definitions.
steps.client_expectation: The client crafts a workbench and then wooden and stone tools from package-authored recipes without host-embedded Terrenia defaults.
steps.headless_expectation: Headless command injection crafts the same workbench and wooden and stone tools with identical recipe receipts.
authoritative_assertions: Crafting produces a workbench and wooden and stone tools from package-authored definitions.
Removing the tools package fails required-dependency preflight before any writer opens.
Recipe output is independent of source discovery order.

steps.description: Use the correct tool to mine faster, consume durability, receive drops, and fail explicitly when the required tool class or tier is absent.
steps.client_expectation: Client mining with the selected hotbar tool applies the correct mining multiplier, consumes durability on success, and receives predicate-matching drops.
steps.headless_expectation: Headless command injection mines the same blocks with identical speed, durability, and drop receipts and without a window or GPU.
authoritative_assertions: The correct tool mines faster than the hand or an incompatible tool.
Successful mining consumes durability atomically with the authoritative action.
Correct-tool drop predicates are independent from mining-speed predicates.
A block that requires a missing tool class or tier fails explicitly without a drop.

steps.description: Place blocks from the hotbar and build a small recognizable structure. The current finite -8..8 playable fixture is a non-production smoke only; in-memory break/place is not a durable writer.
steps.client_expectation: Client placement consumes the selected hotbar item, writes the block through authoritative receipts, and advances the owning chunk revision. The finite fixture place path is a non-production smoke only.
steps.headless_expectation: Headless command injection places the same blocks with identical receipts and chunk revisions and does not treat the finite fixture as production placement.
authoritative_assertions: Placement from the hotbar conserves items and advances only the edited chunk revision.
Placed and broken blocks remain authoritative independent of mesh or collider rebuilds.
The current finite -8..8 playable fixture is a non-production smoke only and does not claim a durable writer.

steps.description: Checkpoint player position, inventory, tool durability, placed and broken blocks, and included v1 containers or scheduled work.
steps.client_expectation: The client can request a checkpoint that persists the latest durable player and world revision without presenting derived mesh state as authoritative.
steps.headless_expectation: Headless command injection writes the same checkpoint bytes and refuses a checkpoint that would open an unauthorized writer.
authoritative_assertions: A checkpoint captures player position, inventory, tool durability, and placed or broken blocks.
Checkpoint persistence uses atomic transactions and does not regenerate materialized chunks.
Recoverable read-only mode never opens a writer.

steps.description: Exit the world with a confirmed clean shutdown after the latest durable state is preserved.
steps.client_expectation: The client leaves the world only after the latest durable revision is preserved and the clean-shutdown marker is written.
steps.headless_expectation: Headless command injection exits the same world session with the same clean-shutdown marker and without a window or GPU.
authoritative_assertions: Exit preserves the latest durable player and world state before the session ends.
A clean-shutdown marker is written only after durable state is committed.
Low-disk and shutdown-timeout paths still preserve the latest durable state.

steps.description: Reopen the world and recover player position, inventory, tool durability, placed and broken blocks, included v1 containers or scheduled work, and the exact generation epoch without regenerating materialized chunks.
steps.client_expectation: The client continues the same world from durable storage and resumes at the recovered pose and inventory without re-resolving the frozen lock.
steps.headless_expectation: Headless command injection reopens the same world and asserts identical recovered state without a window or GPU.
authoritative_assertions: Reopen recovers player position, inventory, tool durability, and placed or broken blocks from durable storage.
Reopen restores the exact generation epoch without regenerating materialized chunks.
Stale async work cannot overwrite a newer revision after reopen.
